name: azul_widgets_the_video_card_overlay_lets_the_video_show_through
description: The Video card lays a button over the whole video: a click anywhere plays or pauses it. The button must be see-through, or it hides every frame the widget shows under it. A raw <button> becomes azul's Button widget, whose face is opaque; the card sets the overlay's background to transparent, and the app's background replaces the widget's face.
